channel.title: New Straits Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from New Straits Times (nst.com.my)

item.title: MCA vows to remain 'voice of reason' in Malaysian politics
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: MCA has vowed to remain the "voice of reason" in the Malaysian political landscape, regardless of its position in the government or the opposition.

item.title: Max Verstappen crashes out on his first qualifying lap in Melbourne
item.description: MELBOURNE: Max Verstappen crashed out on his very first qualifying lap of the new Formula 1 season for Sunday’s curtain-raiser in Australia, PA Media/dpa reported.

item.title: Nine tonnes of waste cleared from elderly hoarder's home in Taman Sentosa
item.description: JOHOR BARU: Authorities have cleared nine tonnes of rubbish and discarded items from the home of an elderly man in Taman Sentosa here following complaints from neighbours.

item.title: India's Bumrah only 'human' says Phillips ahead of T20 World Cup final
item.description: AHMEDABAD: New Zealand will be ready to pounce if India’s bowling star Jasprit Bumrah falters in the T20 World Cup final said all-rounder Glenn Phillips on Friday.

item.title: Isham rejects Zahid's 'Rumah Bangsa' invite over Umno-DAP ties
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Former Umno Supreme Council member Isham Jalil has rejected Datuk Seri Dr Ahmad Zahid Hamidi’s invitation to join the “Rumah Bangsa” initiative, citing the party’s continued cooperation with DAP.

item.title: Arteta warns Arsenal to preserve reputation in Mansfield clash
item.description: LONDON: Mikel Arteta has warned his Arsenal stars to ensure the club’s reputation is not tarnished by an FA Cup giant-killing at Mansfield on Saturday.

item.title: Man City aren't a 'complete team' admits Guardiola
item.description: LONDON: Pep Guardiola knows Manchester City are not a “complete team” but he is convinced they can still overhaul Arsenal in the Premier League title race.

item.title: Tatum's 'emotional' return, Wemby magic sparks Spurs
item.description: LOS ANGELES: Jayson Tatum made a triumphant return from long-term injury as the Boston Celtics defeated the Dallas Mavericks 120-100 in the NBA on Friday.

item.title: Russell puts Mercedes on pole at Australian Grand Prix
item.description: MELBOURNE: Mercedes driver George Russell took pole position at Formula One’s season-opening Australian Grand Prix ahead of teammate Kimi Antonelli on Saturday.

item.title: Shahril Hamdan not rejoining Umno for now
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Former Umno information chief Shahril Sufian Hamdan, who was suspended from the party in 2023, said it is not yet time for him to return.
